language.name: English
layout.utc: Every time and every day is in UTC.
entry.title: Enter a demo workspace
entry.intro: A demo workspace comes with links and synthetic traffic. Entering one takes no account and no password, and what you do inside is deleted when the workspaces are created again.
entry.cookie: Entering sets one cookie, which holds the session and nothing else. The session lasts twelve hours, or thirty minutes without use.
entry.none: This installation has no demo workspace to enter.
links.title: Links
links.caption: The links of the workspace, the oldest first
links.name: Link
link.synthetic: This is a demo workspace: its traffic is synthetic, generated by the seed.
link.through: Figures with the events processed up to {moment}.
link.rules: Traffic classified with version {version} of the rules.
link.rules_changed: The classification rules changed in this period:
metric.requests.definition: Times the link redirected, whoever asked: it includes crawlers, previews and repeated clicks.
metric.estimated_human_clicks.definition: Redirects that the rules do not take for automated. It is an estimate from the headers of the request and errs by excess: not people and not unique clicks.
metric.inactive_requests.definition: Times the link was asked for while it did not redirect, being disabled, blocked or expired.
series.title: How often was the link requested each day?
series.summary: These {days} days had {requests} and {clicks}; the day with the most requests was {date}.
series.empty: The link was not requested in these {days} days.
series.caption: Requests and estimated human clicks of each day
referrers.title: Which sites did the estimated human clicks come from?
referrers.summary: “{site}” has {clicks} of a total of {total}, more than any other value.
referrers.empty: There was no estimated human click in these {days} days.
referrers.caption: Estimated human clicks by referring site
referrers.definition: The site is the host the request names as where it came from: only the host is kept, never the whole address. The table counts estimated human clicks only.
notfound.title: Not found
notfound.text: There is no page at this address.
failed.title: Something failed
failed.text: The page could not be prepared. Try again in a moment.
refused.title: The request was refused
refused.text: This form was sent from another site, so nothing was done. Go back to the panel and send it from one of its pages.
limited.title: Too many entries
limited.text: Too many sessions were opened from this address in a minute. Wait a moment and try again.
insecure.title: No session can be opened at this address
insecure.text: This installation is set up for a local run: it issues its session cookie only on a loopback address, such as localhost. At any other address it has to be served over HTTPS and be set up for it.
